profile_page_not_member: You are not a member of that organisation.
profile_page_work_goals: Your quota and how it is pacing
profile_page_work_timesheet: Hours you have logged this week
profile_page_phone_hint: Digits and separators only. Leave blank to remove it.
profile_page_switch_note: Switching organisation signs you in again with a new token. Which org you are in decides which records exist for you at all, so it is not a filter you can toggle.
profile_page_role_hint: Set by an admin. You cannot change your own role.
profile_page_api_tokens_hint: Each one signs in as you, with your role.
profile_page_calendar_feed_hint: Your open tasks in Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar.
profile_page_sign_in_method_body: {email}, by Google or an emailed code. There is no password to change.
profile_tokens_created_body: This is the only time the full token is shown. Store it somewhere safe; it cannot be retrieved again.
profile_tokens_empty_body: A token lets a script, an integration or an agent call the API as you, with your role and your org. Create one when you need it, and revoke it the moment you do not.
profile_tokens_warning_body: It authenticates as your profile and inherits your role and your org, so anyone holding it can do what you can. Keep it out of shared repositories and screenshots, and revoke it here the moment it is not needed. An admin can see and revoke it too.
profile_tokens_err_not_yours: That token is not one of yours.
profile_feed_err_issue: Could not create the calendar feed.
profile_feed_err_disable: Could not turn the calendar feed off.
profile_feed_url_title: Your feed URL, copy it now
profile_feed_url_body: This is the only time it is shown. Paste it into your calendar app below. If you lose it, regenerate it.
profile_feed_intro_title: Your open tasks, in your calendar
profile_feed_intro_body: Tasks that are New or In progress and have a due date, from 90 days ago to a year ahead, as all-day events. Each shows the title, the priority and a link back here.
profile_feed_read_at: A calendar app read the feed {when}.
profile_feed_never_read: No calendar app has read it yet.
profile_feed_regen_body: Either one stops the current URL at once, and calendars subscribed to it stop updating.
profile_feed_regen_explain: The old URL stops working. Subscribe again with the new one.
profile_feed_off_explain: The URL stops working and subscribed calendars stop updating.
profile_feed_on_body: Creates your private feed URL and shows it once.
profile_feed_google_body: On a computer, open Google Calendar. Beside Other calendars choose +, then From URL, paste the feed URL and choose Add calendar. Google refreshes it every few hours, so changes take a while to appear.
profile_feed_outlook_body: In Outlook on the web choose Add calendar, then Subscribe from web, paste the feed URL and choose Import.
profile_feed_apple_body: Choose File, then New Calendar Subscription, and paste the feed URL.
profile_feed_key_body: Anyone who has it can see the titles and priorities of your open tasks, without signing in. Share it with nobody but your calendar app, and regenerate it if it leaks. It stops working on its own if you leave the organisation or your account is deactivated.
profile_alerts_email_hint: An email when a lead is assigned to you or enquires again.
profile_alerts_push_hint: A push to the BottleCRM app. In-app notifications are always kept.
profile_alerts_save_failed: Could not save your alert settings.
profile_webhook_format_json: Signed JSON (Zapier, n8n, your own code)
